countries.name: United Kingdom

countries.name: Ireland

Does your R&D project involve systematic investigative or experimental activities in a field of science or technology, with the aim of achieving a scientific or technological advancement? (Yes/No)
Will your company bear the R&D expenditure and retain the rights to use or exploit the results of the R&D? (Yes/No)
Is your organisation a trading company, not a public research organisation, charity, or other exempt entity, that can claim this tax credit? (Yes/No)
Do you maintain contemporaneous documentation of your R&D activities, such as project plans, lab notebooks, technical reports, timesheets for R&D work? (Yes/No)

countries.name: Canada
questions: Is your business a Canadian taxpayer, for example a corporation subject to Canadian income tax, and are the R&D activities performed within Canada? (Yes/No)

Does your R&D work attempt to achieve a scientific or technological advancement by overcoming scientific or technological uncertainties through a systematic investigation, experimentation or analysis? (Yes/No)
Will your company incur the R&D expenditures and retain the resulting know how or intellectual property so your company benefits from the results? (Yes/No)
Is your organisation a taxable entity, for example a for profit company, partnership, or individual, rather than a tax exempt or government entity? (Yes/No)
Do you maintain contemporaneous documentation of your R&D work, such as project plans, design documents, experiment logs, time tracking for R&D tasks? (Yes/No)

countries.name: United States

Does your R&D project aim to develop a new or improved product, process, or technology by resolving technological uncertainties through experimentation? (Yes/No)
Will your company bear the expenses of the R&D and retain substantial rights to the results so the research is not fully funded by another party? (Yes/No)
Is your organisation a business for profit entity rather than a government or tax exempt organization? (Yes/No)
